relatedSchemas.description: EXTEND only: schemaId of each topic in otherTopics whose laws the plan needs. Empty otherwise.

choices.description: CLARIFY only: the concrete options the question offers, each a short complete phrase. Empty otherwise.

durationParameter.description: Optional name of a seconds-valued duration control; initial value equals durationSeconds.

physicsModels.description: Bindings to approved capability equations. Every model has a unique id, capabilityId and inputs mapping canonical input keys to a parameter name, another participant's result (its id, a dot and an output key) or an SI numeric constant. Do not put executable formulas here.

after.description: Optional: id of the participant whose end starts this one.

until.description: Optional: this participant ends when the watched result reaches the value.

field.description: A participant id, a dot and an output key, or the id, a dot and t for the time since that participant started.

value.description: An SI number in the field's unit, or a parameter name.

requiredObjects.description: Every object the user names or counts.

observables.description: The computed results the learner watches, most important first.

field.description: A participant id, a dot and one of its output keys.

object.description: The object it belongs to, named as in requiredObjects.

label.description: Its name in the user's words.
